context: Ren reports a negotiation outcome to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (合意/勢い/冒頭/おっしゃる/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 交渉で、合意に達しました。
lines.en: We reached an agreement in the negotiation.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 先方は、冒頭から前向きだったかね?
lines.en: Was the other side positive from the opening?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 冒頭から、勢いがありました。
lines.en: There was momentum from the opening.
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 担当者は、何とおっしゃっていたかね?
lines.en: What did the person in charge say?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 長く付き合いたいと、おっしゃっていました。
lines.en: They said they want a long relationship.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 時間をかけた甲斐が、あったな。
lines.en: The time we spent paid off.
lines.style: satisfied boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この勢いで、合意を広げたいです。
lines.en: With this momentum, I want to widen the agreement.
lines.style: resolved young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 次も、力をかけて取り組もう。
lines.en: Let's put effort into the next one too.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
